depth: No measured depth map. Explicit analytic cosine mound inside existing authored reach; not source depth.

driver.otherPhysics: preserve non-bust constraints; replace only two old bust constraints with finite scale-only drivers using existing inertia/strength/damping/mass/wind/gravity
driver.anchor: upper support in authored parent-bone coordinates; y offset is reach, transformed by existing parent matrix, not a physical depth
driver.finiteLength: same authored reach value, not a measured tissue or depth dimension

render.frames: same fixed viewport; offline, no browser; original PNG bytes untouched

bars.normalGate: ordinary cli.ts build --profile spine, failure stops; no emitted JSON edits
bars.settled: displacement from the initial neutral chest-relative pose <= max(0.05 * peak, 0.05 world units), remains below threshold through end; operational trace definition, not visual quality bar
bars.visual: root evaluates actual same-source side-by-side/contact sheet; no arbitrary volume-preservation claim
bars.lightHeavy: report measured peaks/times/zero-crossings/settling; no preset success inferred from labels

controls: mode-none must differ from volume under nonzero scale response
outside-region support must not move relative to corresponding before condition
runtime comparison uses actual mesh vertices, not bone names
noop-rebind preserves original bones and weights; inverse-bind same native rest positions to measure representational floor independently
scope: Only Roa. Generated results are untracked experiment outputs; never commit them or alter original config/inputs/out. No other character build.

landmarks.meaning: authored nearest-mesh sample locations for central shirt placket; not pixel-measured seam annotations
